anchor: The Chronos control reproduces the committed figures to within run noise (<1%).
claim_text: Chronos control reproduces results within <1% run noise.

adjudication.observed: 25 figures compared; 9 exceeded 1% threshold; maximum absolute difference was 11.31071480358614%
adjudication.evidence: Current non-superseded Chronos control data (a12) vs baseline (a11, lead_s=60) exceed the 1% threshold for 9 of 25 latency figures.
adjudication.fix: Update the text to reflect that Chronos control reproduces figures to within 11.3% run noise (or omit the 1% claim).
adjudication.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_compared, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pct_diff > 1.0) AS exceed_1pct, MAX(pct_diff) AS max_pct_diff FROM (SELECT ABS(a12.p50_ms - a11.p50_ms) / a12.p50_ms * 100 AS pct_diff FROM provenance.v_pool_latency a12 JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency a11 ON a11.experiment = 'a11' AND a12.window_name = a11.window_name AND a12.policy = a11.policy AND a12.forecast_model = a11.forecast_model AND a12.sla_metric = a11.sla_metric AND a11.is_current = true AND a11.lead_s = 60 WHERE a12.is_current = true AND a12.experiment = 'a12' AND a12.forecast_model = 'chronos' AND a12.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND a12.p50_ms > 0 UNION ALL SELECT ABS(a12.p90_ms - a11.p90_ms) / a12.p90_ms * 100 AS pct_diff FROM provenance.v_pool_latency a12 JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency a11 ON a11.experiment = 'a11' AND a12.window_name = a11.window_name AND a12.policy = a11.policy AND a12.forecast_model = a11.forecast_model AND a12.sla_metric = a11.sla_metric AND a11.is_current = true AND a11.lead_s = 60 WHERE a12.is_current = true AND a12.experiment = 'a12' AND a12.forecast_model = 'chronos' AND a12.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND a12.p90_ms > 0 UNION ALL SELECT ABS(a12.p99_ms - adjudication.observed: 25 figures compared: 19 were within <1%, 6 were not; maximum absolute difference was 3.874005819942519%.
adjudication.evidence: Current, non-superseded per-window comparison shows the universal <1% bound fails for 6 of 25 figures.
adjudication.fix: State that 19 of 25 figures were within <1%, with a maximum absolute difference of 3.874005819942519%, rather than claiming all figures were within <1%.
adjudication.query: WITH committed AS (SELECT p.window_name, p.sla_metric, v.metric, v.value FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = p.run_id AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('p50_ms', p.p50_ms), ('p90_ms', p.p90_ms), ('p99_ms', p.p99_ms), ('max_ms', p.max_ms)) v(metric, value) WHERE p.is_current = true AND p.experiment = 'a12' AND p.forecast_model = 'chronos' AND p.run_id LIKE 'a12:%fc_chronos' AND v.value IS NOT NULL), control AS (SELECT p.window_name, p.sla_metric, v.metric, v.value FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = p.run_id AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('p50_ms', p.p50_ms), ('p90_ms', p.p90_ms), ('p99_ms', p.p99_ms), ('max_ms', p.max_ms)) v(metric, value) WHERE p.is_current = true AND p.experiment = 'g2' AND p.forecast_model = 'chronos' AND p.run_id LIKE 'g2:loop_%_fc_chronos_base_L60' AND v.value IS NOT NULL), comparisons AS (SELECT c.window_name, c.sla_metric, c.metric, c.value AS committed_value, r.value AS control_value, abs(r.value - c.value) / abs(c.value) * 100.0 AS abs_diff_pct FROM committed c JOIN control r USING (window_name, sla_metric, metric)) SELECT window_name, sla_metric, metric, committed_value, control_value, abs_diff_pct, count(*) OVER () AS figures_compared, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs_diff_pct < 1.0) OVER () AS figures_within_lt_1_pct, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs_diff_pct >= 1.0) OVER () AS figures_not_within_lt_1_pct, max(abs_diff_pct) OVER () AS max_abs_diff_pct FROM comparisons ORDER BY window_name, sla_metric, metric
